behavior.default: Manual settings save remains default; autosave is explicit and scoped to the current editor session
behavior.write: Two-second idle debounce uses unchanged tenant-bound atomic expectedRevision PATCH and one acknowledged audit per revision
behavior.safety: One in-flight write, invalid drafts do not schedule, any failure disables autosave, conflict/uncertain outcomes never retry automatically, import/recovery/reload disables autosave

publication.required: Own exact final commit: three jobs/every required step and four artifact bytes/digests/CRC/reports
publication.finalReceipt: External ux01j-final-ci-receipt.json paired with source ZIP

limits: Autosave is opt-in per editor session; no automatic merge or cross-device synchronization
